packets.goal: One separately approved quantitative target method.
packets.conditional_gate: No quantitative target-ranking/inference method was approved in the inspected settlement; it cannot be invented during implementation.

acceptance.criterion: A specific approved estimator/score, reference universe, comparison, null and target-family protocol are frozen before coding.
